English: Boat Dragway
A muddy shoreline where boats are dragged ashore and hastily repaired. Marked by tracks through reeds and sand, it is the most basic infrastructure for seaborne raiders.
Reed Dock
A makeshift dock built from bundled reeds and driftwood, providing slightly improved landing and resupply for small raiding parties.
Wicker Boat Shelter
Light structures of woven branches and hides, giving raiders’ boats and gear modest protection from the elements, and enabling faster turnarounds for expeditions.
Longboat Slipway
A timbered ramp and rails for launching and retrieving longboats, enabling rapid deployment and maintenance for larger raiding fleets.
Timber Wharf
A solid wooden wharf with mooring posts, warehouses, and space for crew mustering, greatly boosting raider logistical capabilities.
Shielded Landing
A fortified landing zone with palisades, watchfires, and concealed approaches, protecting raiders and vessels from ambush and weather alike.
Sailmakers Shed
A dedicated structure for weaving, repairing, and storing sails and rigging, allowing for swift refitting and longer-range expeditions.
Raiders' Hut
A cluster of well-built huts for elite raider captains and their retinues, with communal firepits and rallying banners, strengthening clan bonds and morale.
Viking Shipyard
A sprawling shipyard of seasoned oak and stone, staffed by master shipwrights and boasting drydocks, armories, and barracks for the most ambitious raiding campaigns.
North Sea Stronghold
A legendary bastion on the waves, combining shipyards, fortified walls, great halls, and rallying grounds—supreme headquarters for North Germanic raids and dominance at sea.
